physics: H2g manifests and exact 2804-slot mesh unchanged; no fit or equation changes

directions.k: fixed anchor, saved original scalar space only

anchors.A: largest theta in [0,1] with cold+theta*(B-cold) in seen [.501,1.999]; one inward floating-point guard
anchors.B: exact cold outer k, conditional on verified actual-limit obstruction of A; no adaptive anchors
anchors.epsilon_origin: same retracted epsilon; eight saved directions free

seen_sets: complete native scalar/covariance inventory with sided membership
fresh_set: one terminal GL28, only after seen/native qualification; never used to tune
phase_I: minimize transformed-tensor slack alone; inner and outer A+tI PSD; actual scalars and velocity/quadratic caps hard
unbuffered_obstruction: same fixed-k anchor; rebuild original delta, epsilon bounds and covariance cuts; checked primal/dual lower bound and native rounding allowance required
coefficient_bounds: derived from consistent-mass ellipsoid and independent scalar response rows; no arbitrary trust boxes

conditioning.reuse: H2g saved transforms; no regeneration of basis shapes

numerical_checks.native_acceptance: unchanged; delta qualification allowance 1e-12; existing independent divergence allowance 1e-8

termination: stop at qualified candidate, checked limited obstruction after allowed anchors, or aggregate time/scan/round/numerical limit; latter inconclusive; no automatic extension

flat_diagnostic.objective: L2 error squared + H_A^2 physical gradient error squared
flat_diagnostic.compatible_traces: retained native L2 values; W, epsilon and pressure fixed

pilot.rollback: deliberate post-assignment failure separate from unexpected rejection

physical_segment_safeguard: A segment from a true hard-feasible state to an LP trial may be clipped by exact sampled caps and four physical quadratic forms. This is not a new objective, trust box, or final native projection. Every retained trial receives a full true scan.
terminal_selection: Qualified candidate if available; otherwise latest permitted anchor best true non-covariance-hard diagnostic. No selection using fresh GL28.
